title: feat(metadata-core, metadata-protocol): an App and its modules share one customization pair
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiP9RS1KjicEPyef7VNhFzFa)_

Fixes #29594

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md (the "Customizing an installed package" paragraph names one pair per base; it should say a module of an App customizes in the App's pair)

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：一个 App 和它带来的模块现在共用一个定制包 `<App id>.custom`。HotCRM 的销售 App 和 3 个模块，无论从哪个包点「定制」，都落进同一个 `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`。
- 为什么改：按裁决 6691022506，定制单位是 App。以前每个模块各要一个定制包，命名空间相撞时直接 422，HotCRM 的模块根本定制不了。
- 风险与回滚：旧版本给模块建的按包定制包继续被读取和服务，不迁移、不删除；它占着 App 的命名空间时，ensure 门回 409 说明原因，不再回 422。回滚就是还原本 PR，已建的 App 定制包仍是普通可写包。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts`（appOf / pairOf / pairsOf），然后 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts`（ensure 门）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/runtime && npx vitest run --project local src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`，看「App unit」两组用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

The customization unit is the App, as ruled on #29594 (ruling record 6691022506):

> **The customization unit is the App** (ADR-0019 D1–D4: the `type: app` package and the `type: module` / `plugin` packages its artifact brings; ADR-0130 D1/D6: one artifact, one version). One pair per App: `<app id>.custom` (HotCRM → `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`), namespace = the App package's own namespace + `_custom`, dependency = the App's `^major`. A module never owns a pair. Customize on any object of any member lands in the App's pair; the ensure door returns the App's existing pair (200) instead of 422. 422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` stays for a namespace held by a package outside the App's artifact (registry `coOwnersOf()` arms unchanged).

Kernel objects stay not customizable in this version (ruling record 6691217245). ADR-0146 D3 as amended by #31027 governs; merge questions 10, 11 and 12 are implemented as written.

- **`appOf` reads the installed manifests** (`packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts`). A `type: 'app'` package is its own App. Any other package's App is the installed non-kernel `type: 'app'` package it declares in `manifest.dependencies`; with none declared directly, the walk follows declared parents and stops at the first App on each path (cycle-safe, kernel and uninstalled ids skipped). Several Apps: the one holding the package's namespace; none of them, or several: `undefined`, and `pairOf` refuses with `no_single_app` (merge question 11). A package that declares no App is its own unit (N2 holds). A kernel package (scope `system` / `cloud`) keeps its own answer, because no platform pair is created in this version; a new metadata-protocol pin holds that list equal to `READ_ONLY_PACKAGE_SCOPES`.
- **Two questions, two readers.** `pairOf(base)` answers where a customization of `base` lands (the App's pair). `pairsOf(base)` / `isPairOf(pair, base)` answer which packages' rows are `base`'s customizations: the App's pair, then the per-package pair an earlier version created for `base` when it is installed (merge question 12). Every read site PR 2 threaded now asks `pairsOf` / `isPairOf`: list reads, layered reads, overlay merge, served-overrides census, translation bundle binding, environment rows.
- **The ensure door** (`protocol-customization-package.ts`) answers the App's pair for any member: id, namespace `<app ns>_custom`, dependency `{ [app]: ^<app major> }`, name `<App name> (custom)`, and `basePackageId` = the App. `201` the first time any member asks, `200` after. Refusals: a kernel base `409` (unchanged); `no_single_app` `409`; the App namespace held by a legacy pair of a member of the same App `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming it (it stays installed and served; never created beside it); held by any package outside the App `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (unchanged).
- **Write closure.** `widenPairClosureToAppMembers` (`protocol-write-package-scope.ts`) lets a pair whose closure includes its App reach every installed package whose `pairOf` is that pair, so an override or an `object_extension` of a module's item saved into the App's pair is admitted. The packaged-base refusal's pending-pair scope uses the same widening.
- **Census** (`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`): the incomplete-declaration census reads the base from the row's declared `overrides.package` checked against `isServedOverrideRowOf`, instead of deriving it from the pair id, so a module's override in the App's pair is listed under the module.
- **Uninstall** (`registry.ts`): the refusal for an installed pair reads the pair named for the package among `pairsOf`. Uninstalling the App is refused while the App's pair is installed; uninstalling a module is not; a module whose own earlier pair is installed is still refused naming it.
- **Lint** (`validate-customization-namespace.ts`): `namespace-no-customization-pair` skips a delivered package whose `appOf` is another delivered package. `@objectstack/lint` gains a `workspace:*` dependency on `@objectstack/metadata-core`.
- **Dogfood helper** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/customization-pair.ts`): `ensurePair` reads the pair id from the door's answer and asserts it.
- Docs: `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`, `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`.
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` is not edited by this PR (draft PR #31093 edits it; no overlap).

### N1 rule (decided here)

A per-package pair an earlier version created for a module (namespace e.g. `crm_svc_custom`) is **not moved** by this PR: it stays its own installed package and is served beside the App's pair through `pairsOf`. When a move ceremony is built, the objects it carries keep their `crm_svc_custom_<short>` names as a **declared exception**, and the App's pair is not given a set of namespaces. Why: no live instance exists to move; renaming a data-holding table is refused by the platform; and a namespace set would permanently widen what the App's pair owns, where a declared exception stays visible and bounded.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.test.ts`: 13 resolution rows (App, HotCRM module, module with a kernel dependency, nested module, plugin with two Apps where one holds the namespace, two Apps where neither does, standalone App, own-unit plugin, cycle, uninstalled App dependency, kernel, kernel declaring an App, no namespace), nothing-installed equals the old derivation, HotCRM's four packages answer one pair, legacy arm of `pairsOf` / `isPairOf`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`, "the App unit": module first then App and others `[201, 200, 200, 200]`, one pair, one publish; outside-App namespace `422`; legacy member pair `409` from the App and every module, legacy unchanged; two-App plugin `409`; own-unit plugin its own pair `201`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`: the HotCRM-shape rehearsal (below).
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts`: the App refused naming the App's pair, a module not; a module with its legacy pair refused naming it.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.test.ts`: a module's override in the App's pair is listed under the module.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability-kernel-scopes.test.ts`: `appOf`'s kernel scopes equal `READ_ONLY_PACKAGE_SCOPES`.

### Rehearsal

HotCRM (`dev:crm`) is not reachable from this checkout, so the rehearsal is an in-repo fixture of the same shape, run through the real dispatcher and the real lookup (nothing stubbed): App `app.objectstack.hotcrm` (namespace `crm`) and three modules `…service` / `…revenue` / `…marketing` (type `module`, namespace `crm`, each declaring the App `^6`), registered with `engine.registerApp` on a SqlDriver `:memory:` kernel. Ensure via `HttpDispatcher.handlePackages` answers `[[app, 201, app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom], [service, 200, same], [revenue, 200, same], [marketing, 200, same]]` with one pair installed. An `object_extension` adding `sla_tier__c` to the module object `crm_service_case` is saved and published into the App's pair; `getMetaItem`, `getMetaItemLayered` and the registry read it back, its extenders are `[app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom]`, and a record inserted with `sla_tier__c: 'gold'` stores it.

## Acceptance notes

- Negative pins were ablated (refused behaviour put back, build, dist preflight, run red, restore with blob == HEAD):
  - 422 kept for an outside-App namespace: the same-App guard forced true → 3 red (`the namespace held by a package outside the App: 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT still, asked from a module` and the two older 422 pins); restored → green.
  - Kernel 409: the kernel-scope check disabled → 5 red (kernel `system` / `cloud` ensure, kernel legacy pair, flow clone for both scopes); restored → green.
  - App resolution: `appOf`'s single-App answer replaced by the package itself → 3 red (module-first ensure, legacy-pair 409, rehearsal); restored → green.
- Known limits, left as follow-ups: the pair-added bundle member reader (`protocol-write-gates.ts`) reads only the App's pair, not a legacy pair; no ceremony re-identifies a legacy pair as the App's (merge question 12 leaves it open); the six `ui/packages/app-shell` call sites that spell `customizationPackageId(base)` (domain:ui); the list-row `customizable` flag needs a spec sub-card.
